BenpayVideo.description: Create a video from text with BenPay.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Choose a model or enter its ID.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the video you want to create.

duration.name: Duration (seconds)
duration.tooltip: Set the video duration in seconds.

generation.name: Generation
generation.tooltip: Keep unchanged to resume the existing task. Use Regenerate to start another video.

BenpayVideoFromImages.description: Create a video from images with BenPay.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Choose a model or enter its ID.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe the video you want to create.

duration.name: Duration (seconds)
duration.tooltip: Set the video duration in seconds.

image_mode.name: Image mode
image_mode.tooltip: Choose first frame, first and last frame, or reference images.

images.name: First frame / reference images
images.tooltip: Connect one first-frame image, or a batch of reference images.

generation.name: Generation
generation.tooltip: Keep unchanged to resume the existing task. Use Regenerate to start another video.

last_frame.name: Last frame
last_frame.tooltip: Required only for First and last frames mode. Connect one image.
